answer: Attackers forging thousands of identities must fund each bond, so cost scales linearly while honest agents reuse one stake. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every epoch a random pulse of peers audits a sample, slashing bonds for duplicate fingerprints. Like lichen pigment on tundra rock, verified history accumulates slowly and cannot be faked cheaply, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
